items.text: A platform's marketing, pricing page, and testimonials tell you about the business.
A well-reviewed platform can still hand you a poorly matched counsellor.
Not every conversation adds the same thing.

items.text: Ask what their formal training actually is and how long they have practised.
Years of practice matter less than range.

items.text: Answers questions about their own training and background specifically, not vaguely.
